questions: admission ke liye kya karna hai
answer: Admission is done through the online portal. Fill the form, upload marksheets and ID proof, pay the form fee and visit the office for document verification. Eligibility depends on the course.
Fees can be paid online through the college portal (UPI, debit card or net banking) or by DD at the accounts section. Check the notice board for the latest course-wise fee structure.
Exam dates, hall tickets and results are published on the university website and the college notice board. Exam forms must be filled before the last date announced by the exam section.
College timing is 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM, Monday to Saturday. Class-wise timetables are displayed on the department notice board and uploaded on the student portal.

Scholarship applications are filled on the MahaDBT / government portal with income certificate, caste certificate (if applicable) and marksheets. Submit the printout to the scholarship section for verification.

questions: how many books can i borrow

questions: help me make an exam study plan
answer:
Here is a practical 7-day exam study plan:
1. Days 1-2: Review core concepts and high-weightage topics.
2. Days 3-4: Work through formulas, derivations, and practice problems.
3. Days 5-6: Solve past 3 years' university question papers under timed conditions.
4. Day 7: Light revision of short notes, formulas, and get 8 hours of sleep.

The minimum recommended attendance is 75% for lectures and practicals. Formula: Attendance (%) = (Classes attended ÷ Total classes held) × 100. You can check the Attendance Calculator tab in the sidebar to calculate exact figures!

questions: how do i write a good project report
answer:
Guidelines for a standout project report:
1. Abstract & Problem Statement: Clear 1-page summary.
2. System Architecture: Flowcharts, ER diagrams, and UML.
3. Technology Stack: Why you chose Python, Flask, React, etc.
4. Implementation & Modules: Core logic and code structure.
5. Output & Screenshots: Clear pictures of working features.
6. Conclusion & Future Scope: Potential next steps.

questions: help me prepare for placements and interviews
answer:
Placement Preparation Checklist:
1. Core Subjects: Revise OOPs concepts, DBMS queries, OS scheduling, and Data Structures.
2. Coding Practice: Solve array, string, and linked list problems on LeetCode/GeeksforGeeks.
3. Resume: Keep it 1 page, spotlight your projects, tech stack, and GitHub links.
4. HR Round: Practice introducing yourself and explaining why you want to join the company.

questions: how can i improve my concentration while studying
answer:
To boost concentration:
1. Use the Pomodoro Technique: 25 minutes of deep focus + 5 minutes break.
2. Put your phone on 'Do Not Disturb' in another room.
3. Keep a study log and tick off small completed goals.
4. Drink water and take quick walks during breaks to keep energy high.
